name: NetBox
summary: HTTP 8000 checked against the login page.
notes: The port is the one netbox-docker's example publishes; a native install has nginx in front of the application, so point at that nginx. /login/ answers without signing in, while /api/status/ does not unless LOGIN_REQUIRED is off. NetBox refuses forms posted under a name it does not know: list the public address, with https://, in CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS.
